About The Role
 In this role, you'll modernize the internal system-operations applications that keep a client's application platform running smoothly. You'll turn existing Flask and Dash apps into well-structured, CI/CD-ready services, build a shared Python library other teams can reuse, and launch new apps with FastAPI and React. Your work will set the standard for how many applications are built and shipped.
 Responsibilities
Modernize existing Python applications built with Flask and Dash, restructuring them end to end into modular, production-ready services prepared for CI/CD
Build a shared Python library with SQLAlchemy-based data access to MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Databricks, plus reusable app templates that speed up new application setup
Work closely with the client's platform and operations teams to turn their needs into clear technical solutions and shared development standards
Develop new applications with FastAPI and React/TypeScript, keeping business logic, data access, API, and presentation cleanly separated
Standardize and refactor Apache Airflow pipelines to make them consistent, maintainable, and easier to monitor
Set up Git-based workflows and pipeline-based deployments so every application is released in the same reliable way
Write automated tests, review code, and debug issues to keep quality high across applications
Document architecture and usage so other developers can adopt the library and templates independently
 Requirements
3–6 years of professional experience in Python development, including independent design, implementation, and deployment of production-ready applications
Proven experience modernizing existing Python applications end to end with Flask and/or Dash
Hands-on experience building applications with FastAPI, React, and TypeScript
Very good SQL skills and practical experience with SQLAlchemy, MySQL, and PostgreSQL
Experience developing, standardizing, or refactoring Apache Airflow pipelines
Solid practice with Git, CI/CD, and pipeline-based deployments
Experience with automated testing, code reviews, debugging, and technical documentation
Understanding of modular architecture with clear separation of business logic, data access, API, and presentation
Clear, collaborative communication with cross-functional and client teams
Nice to have:
Experience with Databricks and PySpark
Familiarity with Azure DevOps and Azure DevOps pipelines
Experience integrating centrally provided authentication and authorization components
Knowledge of Kubernetes/OpenShift from an application development perspective
Experience standardizing development across several applications or departments
Knowledge of German language
